definitions.explanation: going somewhere with the intention of staying overnight, rather than returning the same day

examples.japanese: {泊|と}まりがけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the hot springs for an overnight stay.

examples.japanese: {泊|と}まりがけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I have an overnight business trip.
I went to stay overnight at my friend's house.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{泊|と}まり→泊まり：22935_tomari⟧ (staying overnight) + がけ, a suffix meaning "with, as part of" (as in ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧がけ, on one's way past).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {泊|と}まりがけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧～: to go somewhere with an overnight stay
- {泊|と}まりがけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: involving an overnight stay ({泊|と}まりがけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧, an overnight business trip)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧: a day trip (returning the same day)
- ⟦{外泊|がいはく}→外泊：17613_gaihaku⟧: staying out overnight, away from home (often unplanned or against rules)
